narrative:
Fulton County has 28,917 registered voters, with 53.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 12.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 21.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.2% of registrants.
